body.description: The body of the note. Should include who/what created the note if this is required.

created_at.description: The date and time the note was created.

document_paths.description:
A list of relative paths in S3 for documents to be attached to the note.

More details on document path parameters can be found here.

external_id.description: Unique identifier for this note to avoid duplicate entries.

is_archived.description: If set to true, this will archive the note in the Kraken account support site page.

is_pinned.description: If set to true, this will pin the note to the top of the Kraken account support site page.

status.description: The creation status for each note attempted to be imported.

x-enum-descriptions.NOTE_CREATION_SUCCESS: The note has been successfully created.
x-enum-descriptions.NOTE_ALREADY_EXISTS: A similar note has been found preventing the creation of a new note.

unpin_at.description: When the pinned note should be unpinned. Has to be later than created_at if this is provided. Has no effect if the note is not pinned.

x-validators.name: Validate note body or document paths provided
x-validators.description: Validate that at least a note body or document paths are provided.

x-validators.name: Validate note created at is equal to or before unpin at
x-validators.description: Validate that the note's created at date is equal to or before the unpin at date if both are provided.

document_path.description: The S3 relative path to the document to be attached to the note.

x-validators.name: Validate path exists in file store
x-validators.description: Validate that the given path corresponds to a file that has previously been uploaded to the migration file store. Note that this validation is disabled by default and can be enabled using the relevant feature flag.
